q: If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, do I activate both the "
1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect and the "delete 1 of their Digimon with a play cost of 6 or less" effect when activating this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] If you have 3 or more security cards, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. If you have 3 or fewer, delete 1 of their Digimon with a play cost of 6 or less.
Inherited Effect: [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has [Pulsemon] in its text, by trashing the top card of your security stack, unsuspend this Digimon.
